dialogue.content: （本日はよろしくお願いいたします。お時間になりましたら始めさせていただきます。よろしくお願いいたします。）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for coming today. We'll begin at the scheduled time. I look forward to our session.)

dialogue.content: （こちらこそよろしくお願いいたします。返信が遅くなってしまい失礼しました）
dialogue.English: (Thank you as well. I apologize for the late reply.)

dialogue.content: こんにちは相談員です。本日はよろしくお願いいたします。よろしければ性別年齢を教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm your counselor. Thank you for coming today. If you don't mind, could you please tell me your gender and age?

dialogue.content: こんにちは。よろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: Hello. Thank you for having me.

dialogue.content: 女、14才です
dialogue.English: I'm a girl, 14 years old.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。今日はどういったご相談ですか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: あの…家にいづらくて、悩んでます
dialogue.English: Um... I'm having trouble feeling comfortable at home, and it's troubling me.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。家に居にくいということですね。帰宅することが苦痛という感じでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. So it's hard to be at home. Does it feel painful to come home?

dialogue.content: えーと
dialogue.English: Um...

dialogue.content: ゆっくりでいいですからね
dialogue.English: Take your time.

dialogue.content: 父が前に再婚して、弟がいるんですけど、まゆみさん（父と結婚した人）が嫌なんです
dialogue.English: My dad remarried a while ago, and I have a younger brother, but I don't like Mayumi (the woman my dad married).

dialogue.content: なるほど、そうだったのですね新しいお母さんがお家にいるのですね。弟さんもですか。それは気を使いそうだよね。
dialogue.English: I see, so that's the situation. You have a new mother figure at home, and your younger brother, too. That must be stressful.

dialogue.content: 弟はまゆみさんの子です
dialogue.English: My brother is Mayumi's child.

dialogue.content: 父と
dialogue.English: With my dad.

dialogue.content: お母さんとは思えないです
dialogue.English: I can't think of her as my mother.

dialogue.content: なるほど。お父さんと三人でいる。。。そこに入っていくのが苦痛なのかな？お母さんにも違和感がいっぱいなんだね。
dialogue.English: I see. So it's your dad with those two... and it's painful for you to join them? It sounds like you feel a lot of discomfort about her as a mother figure.

dialogue.content: まゆみさんはお母さんとは呼んでいません
dialogue.English: I don't call Mayumi 'Mom.'

dialogue.content: まゆみさんは父と結婚したばかりは優しくしてくれたんですけど
dialogue.English: When Mayumi had just married my dad, she was kind to me, but...

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: でも、弟が生まれてからは、父がいない時にちょこちょこいじわるするんです
dialogue.English: But after my brother was born, she started being mean to me in small ways when my dad isn't around.

dialogue.content: 私にだけ
dialogue.English: Only to me.

dialogue.content: えーそうなの。それはなんか悲しいよね。
dialogue.English: Oh, really? That must be so hurtful.

dialogue.content: 悲しい…　そうなのかななんか家にいても、ひとりぼっちの感じです
dialogue.English: Sad... I guess so. Even when I'm at home, it feels like I'm all alone.

dialogue.content: そうなんだね。急にそんなふうな態度されたらそう思ってしまうよね。
dialogue.English: I can understand that. If her attitude suddenly changed like that, it's natural you would feel that way.

dialogue.content: 優しい人なのかもと思ったけど、そうでなかった
dialogue.English: I thought she might be a kind person, but she wasn't.

dialogue.content: ひとりぼっちでさみしい
dialogue.English: I feel all alone and lonely.

dialogue.content: 家を出たいです
dialogue.English: I want to leave home.

dialogue.content: 確かにね。そうなのか。今まで一人で頑張ってきたもんね。家を出たくなってきちゃったのね。
dialogue.English: I understand. You've been trying so hard on your own all this time. So now you've started to feel like you want to leave home.

dialogue.content: はい、早く出たいです
dialogue.English: Yes, I want to leave as soon as possible.

dialogue.content: でも、お金もないし、行くところもないし
dialogue.English: But I don't have any money, and I have nowhere to go.

dialogue.content: そうだよね。出たいけどなかなか実行できないよね。弟が生まれてどのくらい？
dialogue.English: That makes sense. You want to leave, but it's hard to actually do it. How long has it been since your brother was born?

dialogue.content: SNSで仲良くなった友だちが来てもいいよって言ってくれてるので、迷ってます
dialogue.English: A friend I made on social media told me I could come stay with them, so I'm torn.

dialogue.content: 弟は今、7才です
dialogue.English: My brother is 7 now.

dialogue.content: そっか、もう７歳なんだね。弟が生まれてからずっと一人だなって思っていたの？
dialogue.English: I see, he's already seven. Have you been feeling all alone ever since he was born?

dialogue.content: うーん
dialogue.English: Hmm...

dialogue.content: 弟はすごくかわいくて、遊んであげたりしていたので、
dialogue.English: My brother is really cute, and I used to play with him and everything, so...

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: きらいじゃないんですけど、大体あの人が一緒にいるから
dialogue.English: It's not that I dislike him, but she's usually there with him.

dialogue.content: なるほど、まゆみさんが一緒だとイヤなんだ。
dialogue.English: I see, so you don't like it when Mayumi is there with him.

dialogue.content: 弟と二人の時はなかなかない
dialogue.English: I rarely get to be alone with my brother.

dialogue.content: そう、嫌なんです
dialogue.English: Right, I don't like it.

dialogue.content: いじわるだし
dialogue.English: And she's mean.

dialogue.content: どんどんいじわるになってきて
dialogue.English: She's been getting meaner and meaner.

dialogue.content: 最近は、お父さんにいったらかもっとひどいことするよって言うんです
dialogue.English: Lately, she's been saying, "If you tell your dad, I'll do even worse things to you."

dialogue.content: そうなの？そんなにだんだん意地悪になってきたの？
dialogue.English: Is that so? Has she been getting that much meaner?

dialogue.content: はいお父さんも自分のことを信じるから、あんたが言っても無理だよって
dialogue.English: Yes. She says, "Your dad believes me, so it's useless for you to say anything."

dialogue.content: それは本当にひどいね。なんか許せないね！
dialogue.English: That's truly awful. That's unforgivable!

dialogue.content: 弟にはお菓子とかおもちゃとか何でも買ってあげるのに、私にはわざと買わない
dialogue.English: She buys my brother anything he wants, like snacks and toys, but she deliberately doesn't buy anything for me.

dialogue.content: そうなの？そういう時は、何か言い返したりする？
dialogue.English: I see. In those moments, do you ever say anything back?

dialogue.content: 日曜日とか、スーパーでお父さんと一緒に行く時だけわざとらしくこれ好きだよねとか言って、まずそうなお菓子を持ってくるし
dialogue.English: On Sundays, like when we go to the supermarket with my dad, she'll act all fake-nice and say things like, "You like this, right?" and then bring me snacks that look gross.

dialogue.content: 言い返したこともあるけど、
dialogue.English: I've talked back before, but...

dialogue.content: その後もっとひどくなるから
dialogue.English: it just gets worse afterward.

dialogue.content: 何も言わなくなっちゃった
dialogue.English: So I stopped saying anything.

dialogue.content: そうなんだ、なんだか言っても仕方ないかって思ったんだ。でも本当によく一人で耐えてたね。頑張ってきたね
dialogue.English: I see. So you felt like it was pointless to say anything. But you've really endured this all by yourself for so long. You've been trying so hard.

dialogue.content: もう耐えられない
dialogue.English: I can't take it anymore.

dialogue.content: お父さんも全然分かってくれないし
dialogue.English: My dad doesn't understand at all, either.

dialogue.content: そう、本当に偉かったと思うよ。そう思って当然だよ。
dialogue.English: Yes, I think you've been incredibly strong. It's completely natural to feel that way.

dialogue.content: もういなくなりたい
dialogue.English: I just want to disappear.

dialogue.content: もう頑張るのも疲れちゃうよね。わかる。
dialogue.English: You must be tired of trying so hard. I understand.

dialogue.content: いなくなる方法を考えてます
dialogue.English: I'm thinking about ways to disappear.

dialogue.content: いなくなってしまいたいと思うほど辛いんだよね。本当に今まで偉かったよ。頑張りすぎたんだよ。これからは相談員もいるからね。でもさ、お父さんもわかってくれないってことは一度はお父さんに相談してみた
dialogue.English: It's so painful that you feel like you want to disappear. You've truly been so strong up until now. You've tried too hard. From now on, you have me to talk to. But when you say your dad doesn't understand, does that mean you've tried talking to him about it at least once?

dialogue.content: お父さんだまされてるんです！
dialogue.English: My dad is being deceived!

dialogue.content: あの人に
dialogue.English: By her.

dialogue.content: そう思っちゃうな、私も。
dialogue.English: That's what I would think, too.

dialogue.content: 前に言ったけど、気にしすぎだよって言って
dialogue.English: I told him before, but he just said I was overthinking it.

dialogue.content: あの人に聞いていたみたいだけど、そしたら私と仲良くしたいのに、冷たくされてつらいとか言ってたらしいし
dialogue.English: He apparently asked her about it, and she supposedly said that she wants to get along with me, but it's hard because I'm cold to her.

dialogue.content: なんで娘の言ってることを信じないのかわからない
dialogue.English: I don't understand why he won't believe what his own daughter is saying.

dialogue.content: もうお父さんのこともきらい
dialogue.English: Now I hate my dad, too.

dialogue.content: まゆみさんはそういうふうに言っていたんだ。お父さん、もっとちゃんと話聞いて欲しいって思うよね。
dialogue.English: So that's what Mayumi said. You must wish your dad would listen to you more properly, right?

dialogue.content: そうだよね、私を信じて欲しいって思うよね。
dialogue.English: Right. You just want him to believe you, don't you?

dialogue.content: お父さんは娘より赤の他人を信じるんだからもう信じられない
dialogue.English: If my dad believes a complete stranger over his own daughter, then I can't trust him anymore.

dialogue.content: そうだよね。
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: ともだちのところに行こうかと思うけど、ずっといられるわけじゃないと思うしそれならもう私がいなくなっちゃえば楽かなって
dialogue.English: I'm thinking of going to my friend's place, but I don't think I could stay there forever... so then I wonder if it would just be easier if I disappeared.

dialogue.content: そっか、そのSNSの友達のとこ？
dialogue.English: I see. The friend from social media?

dialogue.content: うん
dialogue.English: Yeah.

dialogue.content: そうなんだね。その子にあったことは今まであるの？
dialogue.English: I see. Have you ever met them in person?

dialogue.content: 直接会ったことはないです
dialogue.English: I've never met them in person.

dialogue.content: でも、いつも優しくしてくれて、
dialogue.English: But they're always kind to me,

dialogue.content: 困ったら来ていいよって
dialogue.English: and they said I can come over if I'm in trouble.

dialogue.content: そうなんだ。その友達にお父さんとのこととか話していたりするの？
dialogue.English: I see. Have you talked to that friend about what's going on with your dad and everything?

dialogue.content: うん、してる
dialogue.English: Yeah, I do.

dialogue.content: その友達はなんて返事してくれるの？
dialogue.English: What does your friend say in response?

dialogue.content: ひどいねってよく分かってくれるその子もお母さんいなくて、いろいろ大変だから
dialogue.English: They really understand and say, "That's awful." They don't have a mother either, so they've been through a lot, too.

dialogue.content: そうなんだ、似たような環境なんだね。いろんなことわかってくれるような気がするんだね。
dialogue.English: I see, so you're in similar situations. It must feel like they understand a lot of what you're going through.

dialogue.content: 私よりちょっとお姉さんだから、頼りにしてねって言ってくれる
dialogue.English: They're a little older than me, so they tell me I can rely on them.

dialogue.content: 一人暮らしだからいつ来ても大丈夫だよって
dialogue.English: They live alone, so they say I can come anytime.

dialogue.content: そうなんだ。なんだか優しそうな人のような気がするね。
dialogue.English: I see. They really do sound like a kind person.

dialogue.content: うん、そう
dialogue.English: Yeah, they are.

dialogue.content: でも迷ってる気持ちもあるし
dialogue.English: But I'm also feeling hesitant.

dialogue.content: お話聞いてくれる人がいるっていうのはとてもいいことだと思うよ。お父さん、まゆみさんとのことをそのSNSの友達以外で相談したことはあるのかな？
dialogue.English: I think it's a very good thing to have someone who will listen to you. Have you talked to anyone besides that social media friend about your dad and Mayumi?

dialogue.content: ないです
dialogue.English: No.

dialogue.content: 学校では恥ずかしくていえない友だちもあんまりいないし
dialogue.English: I'm too embarrassed to talk about it at school, and I don't really have many friends anyway.

dialogue.content: 先生やおばあちゃんとか
dialogue.English: What about a teacher or your grandmother?

dialogue.content: 先生は信用できない
dialogue.English: I can't trust my teachers.

dialogue.content: おばあちゃんいない
dialogue.English: I don't have a grandmother.

dialogue.content: そうなんだね。先生にも話したくないんだ。
dialogue.English: I see. So you don't want to talk to your teachers, either.

dialogue.content: うん
dialogue.English: Yeah.

dialogue.content: 先生はどんな感じ？
dialogue.English: What are your teachers like?

dialogue.content: 先生？成績のいい子だけひいきする
dialogue.English: The teachers? They only play favorites with the kids who have good grades.

dialogue.content: そうかあ、それもイヤだね。今まで話やすいなあっていう先生はいなかった？
dialogue.English: I see, that's no good either. Has there ever been a teacher you felt was easy to talk to?

dialogue.content: うーん
dialogue.English: Hmm...

dialogue.content: いない…
dialogue.English: No...

dialogue.content: なんかね、もしそういう先生がいたら、困った時、辛い時親以外の人に話すってとてもいいことだと思ったの。
dialogue.English: You know, I was just thinking that if there were a teacher like that, it's a very good thing to be able to talk to someone other than your parents when you're in trouble or having a hard time.

dialogue.content: もちろんこの相談員でもいいんだけどね。
dialogue.English: Of course, you can always talk to me, too.

dialogue.content: ここの方が話しやすいです
dialogue.English: It's easier to talk here.

dialogue.content: 先生は無理
dialogue.English: I just can't with teachers.

dialogue.content: そうなんだね。ここはいつでもきていいからね
dialogue.English: I see. You're welcome to come here anytime.

dialogue.content: はい家を出たらどうだと思いますか
dialogue.English: Okay... what would you think if I left home?

dialogue.content: 辛い時家出したくなるよね。わかるよ。でも家を出て行きたい気持ちになったら、とりあえず一度まずここにきてくれたら嬉しいけどな。
dialogue.English: It's natural to want to run away from home when things are tough. I get it. But if you feel like you want to leave home, I'd be happy if you could come here and talk to me first.

dialogue.content: 家を出るのは反対ですか
dialogue.English: Are you against me leaving home?

dialogue.content: そう思ってしまう気持ちはすっごくわかる。私がそうだったら同じように思うと思う。でも、その前にお父さんにもう少し話を詳しく話すのも手かなとも思うな。
dialogue.English: I completely understand why you feel that way. If I were in your shoes, I'd probably feel the same. But before you do that, I also think that talking to your dad in a little more detail might be one option.

dialogue.content: お父さんに言うのはこわいな
dialogue.English: I'm scared to tell my dad.

dialogue.content: 確かに、また信じてくれなかったらと思ったら怖い。でも本当の本当の気持ち、まだお父さんに話してないんじゃない？
dialogue.English: I understand, it's scary to think he might not believe you again. But maybe you haven't told your dad your true, deep-down feelings yet?

dialogue.content: うん…
dialogue.English: Yeah...

dialogue.content: こわいな
dialogue.English: I'm scared.

dialogue.content: 分かってくれない気がするし、本当にそうならもう死にたくなる
dialogue.English: I feel like he won't understand, and if that really happens, I'll just want to die.

dialogue.content: そうだね。お父さんに話すのが怖かったら、話すことないからね。でも相談員はいつもここにいますから、いつでも相談にきてね。
dialogue.English: I understand. If you're scared to talk to your dad, you don't have to. But please remember that I'm always here, so you can come and talk to me anytime.

dialogue.content: はい、またきめす
dialogue.English: Okay, I'll come again.

dialogue.content: 今日は相談してくれてありがとう。いつでも相談に来てね。待ってますよ。
dialogue.English: Thank you for talking with me today. Please feel free to come back anytime. I'll be waiting for you.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: こちらこそありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you as well.

dialogue.content: （本日はありがとうございました。）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for your time today.)

dialogue.content: （こちらこそです。ありがとうございました！）
dialogue.English: (The pleasure was mine. Thank you very much!)
